bhajan.title: Ganesha we ask You for Your selfless service, helping us to reach our Sai Baba

discourse.excerpt: Let me tell you that nothing is impossible of achievement if an organised society is set on achieving it. Even liberation from material entanglement (Moksha) can be won through serving and promoting the progress of society.
discourse.theme: True seva is marked by compassion and willingness to sacrifice — and its first classroom is the family.
discourse.title: Lessons on seva saadhana

reflection: Swami's first lesson on seva is disarmingly simple: it has two marks — compassion and willingness to sacrifice — and it begins in the family circle, before ever reaching the wider world. Before planning any grand service, look around your own home: one unprompted act of loving service there is the training ground for everything else. Start where Swami points — within the family. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 15, 19 Nov 1981)
seva_nudge: Do one unprompted act of loving service at home today — a chore, a meal, an errand — without being asked.
